units.source_text: 果然，路修好不到五天，阿清就卧床不起了。

en.t: Sure enough, less than five days after the road was repaired, Aqing took to her bed and could not get up.

units.source_text: 妓馆的一个四岁的女孩和一个吃奶的婴儿，总缠在她的枕边，这才使她没被撵出去。

en.t: A four-year-old girl from the geisha house and a nursing baby were always clinging around her pillow, and that was why she was not driven out.

units.source_text: 但是，这个村里所有的女招待从老板那儿听到的“瞧人家阿笑”这句话，

en.t: But the words that all the waitresses in the village heard from their bosses, "Look at Axiao,"

units.source_text: 也常常在她的睡铺边上旋荡。

en.t: also often seemed to circle and echo beside her sleeping mat.

units.source_text: 而且这个睡铺就在腌菜小房旁边那间仅两叠宽的屋子里。

en.t: And that sleeping mat lay in a room only two tatami mats wide, next to the little pickle shed.

units.source_text: 然而，为了接客，有时这样的小房间也会派上用场。

en.t: Even so, for receiving customers, a small room like that could sometimes be useful.
